_about: Generated by scripts/standings.py from private/submissions/*.status.json and the board snapshots in ~/data/sidechain/vcc2026/leaderboards/ — do not edit by hand; run the script (log_submission.py runs it after recording an entry). rank/teams are the first snapshot that contains the entry: the board re-ranks continuously, so a later look is not the rank when scored. The README table between the standings markers is the same rows.
